Every Hit and Pointed Card in Yu-Gi-Oh

Every card that is banlisted or carries points in at least one format: Genesys (points), TCG (Advanced list), OCG, Master Duel and Duel Links. 1013 cards are ranked into Tiers 0-7 by a single score. Genesys, TCG, OCG and Master Duel drive it, while Duel Links only adds a small bonus. Generic Handtraps are pulled out into their own section at the bottom and keep their old scores until they get a separate system. Hover a card for a larger image, its type, stats and full ban details. Hatched cards are banlisted but had no image or stats in the original list.

Formats

DLbonusDuel Links bonus only

Ban-reason tags weights shown where they add to the score

STUN/FLOODGATEStun/Floodgate +15, red outline
HANDLOOPHandloop +12, purple outline
S-LOCKSummoning Lock (gives card)
FTKFirst-turn kill
SKIPTurn Skip
COMBO SLOPCombo Slop
WINInstant Win

WIPEMass Removal
NEGATENegate/Interrupt
DRAWDraw/Search/Resource
SSSS Engine/Starter
How the score works
  • Format values: Genesys uses its points as-is (100 = effectively unplayable). TCG Advanced, OCG and Master Duel: Forbidden = 100, Limited = 60, Semi-Limited = 40.
  • Combining: the highest of those four is the base; the other three add 20% of their value each, so a card hit in several real formats climbs.
  • Duel Links: a bonus only, up to +10 for Forbidden (Limited 1 +6, Limited 2 +4, Limited 3 +2.5), scaled by how hard the card is hit elsewhere. Cards hit only in Duel Links score under 10 and land in Tier 7.
  • Tiers: Tier 0 = score 130+ after tag bonuses, plus Stun/Floodgate cards scoring 125-129. Tier 1 = a base of 100 in at least one real format (Genesys, TCG, OCG or Master Duel) but under the Tier 0 line. Otherwise score 50+ = Tier 2, 40-49 = Tier 3, 30-39 = Tier 4, 20-29 = Tier 5, 10-19 = Tier 6, under 10 = Tier 7. Within a tier, cards are sorted by score, then by how many formats list them. Generic Handtraps sit outside the tiers; their scores are the old ones, kept until a separate system replaces them.
